brand_identity.emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Alpine Precision & Expedition Authority)

aesthetic_direction.inspiration_mix: The North Face (full-bleed photography, bold uppercase typography, dark cinematic overlays) + Mammut (tactical alpine contrast, alpine red/earth accent triggers, structured technical metadata) + Untitled UI (clean modern React components, generous spacing, sharp 8px grid alignment, crisp micro-borders)
aesthetic_direction.shift_from_previous: Replaced soft luxury editorial cream/navy/serif with bold adventure obsidian/charcoal/bold sans-serif with alpine red triggers
forbidden_anti_patterns: No Cormorant Garamond serif headings (use bold uppercase sans-serif)
No soft pastels or flat light grey cards
No fully transparent headers without backdrop blur
No default un-styled inputs or selects

instructions_to_main_agent: Update tailwind.config.js to define the new color palette (background #090A0C, card #181B22, primary alpine red #FF3B30, border #262B35) and set Plus Jakarta Sans as default sans font.
Update index.css to import Plus Jakarta Sans & JetBrains Mono fonts, and set dark obsidian background by default.
Redesign Header navigation, Hero section, Destination section, Trip Builder page, AI Chat Assistant page, Floating Chat widget, Admin Workspace, and Footer.
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, tabs, modals) have data-testid attributes.
Keep brand name 'Outdooroots' and tagline 'Aventura · Vida · Naturaleza'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the AI slop aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons with hover animation & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
